finalText:
**Found it.** `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` was rounding to 2 decimals twice in USD — once after the percent coupon, once after the flat coupon — before converting to the order's currency. That threw away fractional cents that mattered once converted, so the final total occasionally rounded down a cent from what it should've been.

It only showed up when a percent coupon was in play, since that's what produces the odd fractional cents in the first place — flat-only or no-coupon carts always came out clean.

Fix: stopped rounding mid-calculation and only round once, at the end, after conversion — same as finance's own reference math. All 40 tests pass now (was 10 failing).
